command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
grep -E '  pin\.py$' pins.sha256 | sha256sum -c || { echo "FAIL: pin.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u /tmp/pin.py CA_LassenNP_2020 /tmp/out 64 2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/pin.log
grep -q '^PIN OK' /tmp/out/pin.log || { echo "FAIL: pin"; exit 1; }
( cd /tmp/out && sha256sum pins.tsv > pins.tsv.sha256 && cat pins.tsv.sha256 )
